Name: Starter Kitchen (All Farm types)
Author: nanisnigad
Description:
Adds small Starter Kitchen to All Farm Types. Includes Sink, Stove and side decor cabinets. Functioning Stove.
All the unique decor and wallpapers/flooring are the same as base game. Single & Multi player

Tested adding Wallpaper & Flooring bought from Pierre's Shop (worked). Not tested from Catalogue.
Kitchen is considered separate room so adding flooring/wall will work on the 3x4 space.
[b][u]Warning:[/u][/b] Not tested with upgraded Farmhouse (I just made this mod and haven't played on it enough)

[u]Known Issues:[/u] TV is not usable. Mod required to fix TV.
(Bed was also unusable so I opted to not add it to the initial Furniture spawn, but a default USABLE bed will spawn anyways)

UNKNOWN if my mods are usable with other mods. Works with my Small Forest Farm map.
